TEXT: On the day of Summer Comiket...
Ayase and I took the Rinkai Line from the Shin-Kiba station to the Kokusai-Tenjijou station.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: W-Why is it so crowded even though it isn't morning or evening?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, they're all going to the same place as we are.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah. Look, it'll only get worse once we get there.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Haha. You know, whenever I've gone out lately, it's been with you.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Wouldn't Onee-san... I mean, wouldn't Manami-san get angry?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: I mean, wouldn't it be bad if she found out that we've going out together?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Regardless, I already told Manami I'd be out with you today, Ayase.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: She even prepared water bottles and stuff for us. She's pretty reliable at times like these.
Saying that, I pointed at the backpack I was carrying.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: *sigh* Geez, you're both like that all the time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What are you getting angry about?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I don't really get what you're trying to say, but she did leave me with a message.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Take care and have fun out there, you two!
It seems like Ayase and Manami have formed some kind of bond while I wasn't looking.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: D-Don't you "what's up" me! I-In this kind of place... I'm going to get angry.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Y-You just... touched my butt, didn't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: D-Don't lie. I know you did. I can't picture anyone else here being guilty...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Don't say things like that on a crowded train! Are you trying to end my life?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: B-But... Ah! Y-You did it again...!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: I'll report you if you don't stop!
N-No good. The people around us are starting to notice...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I-It wasn't me! I'm falsely accused!

SPEAKER: SPK_COMMUTER
TEXT: I'm truly sorry. It seems that my kid might have touched your girlfriend.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: W-what? S-So that's what happened! Aha, ahahaha...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's not like I'm mad or anything.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm just that hard to trust. In these situations, the natural choice is to suspect me...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Now you're just being unreasonable... L-Look, I'll buy you some juice.
Exiting the Kokusai-Tenjijou station, we were assaulted by this year's hottest weather.
The air was trembling. A certain scent of summer that threatened to burn your lungs was emanating from the hot asphalt.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: W-What a terribly long queue. Are we really going to queue from all over there?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Are all these people here for...
She's reacting pretty much like I did last year.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Eh? But the queue is over there, isn't it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: True, but we still have to follow the proper order of things before we can queue up.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Woah... The queue is so long...
Seems like the heat is starting to get to her.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's Manami's special barley tea. It's cool and tastes pretty good.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...Thank you. Geez, don't just go putting it on my neck like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...Um, you don't seem to be that bothered by all this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's my second time here, after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Did Kirino queue up like this as well?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah. She was complaining about the heat and smell, all the while playing games on her handheld.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Handheld... Oh, like those over there?
Ayase was pointing at some girls playing God Eater Burst on their handhelds, like what Kirino and Kuroneko did last year...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I happen to have that game with me. Want to try it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: If you do, you might get to play with Kirino some day.
I think it's fine like this, taking it slowly and not overdoing it.
